seasonalTasks.title: Mow primocane raspberry to ground (winter)
seasonalTasks.body: Single-crop management: cut all canes 1 in tall after dormancy; new canes will fruit Aug-Oct.

seasonalTasks.title: SWD trap + spray decision
seasonalTasks.body: Spotted-wing drosophila is the dominant ripe-fruit pest. Pyrethroids on 5–7 d intervals during ripening.

seasonalTasks.title: Fall raspberry harvest
seasonalTasks.body: Pick every 2–3 d. Cool berries to 32–34 °F within 1 h.

notes: Fall-bearing red raspberry. Primocane mow-down management — single 1.5 mo harvest, no summer crop.
